integrity: All finite states covered by three replayable integer-only or vectorized programs. No claim that the older threshold-one results imply the present threshold-two counts. Earliest date is an actual first public arXiv date for the source model, not the claimed finding date.
limitations: Two finite ten-vertex graphs only; exhaustive finite verification rather than a closed all-parameter theorem; possible inaccessible historical equivalent; no external independent validation.
scientific_scope: Complete first all-rest distribution and initial-excitation-weighted terminal layer for synchronous three-state two-contact excitation on GP(5,1) and GP(5,2); a universal four-cycle obstruction for three initially excited sites.
title: A girth-sensitive terminal-excitation census for the two ten-vertex generalized Petersen graphs
